title: Stalk of a representable etale sheaf at a geometric point
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] and $P\to Y$ an etale morphism, so that $P$ is an object of $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $h_P$ be the presheaf $U\mapsto\operatorname{Mor}_Y(U,P)$ on $Y_{\Et}$ and $|P_{\bar y}|$ the geometric fibre of $P\to Y$ over $\bar y$, the set of morphisms $\bar p:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to P$ over $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-fibre]. Then the map from the stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]

$$
(h_P)_{\bar y}=\varinjlim_{(U,\bar u)}\operatorname{Mor}_Y(U,P)\longrightarrow|P_{\bar y}|,\qquad [(U,\bar u),\varphi]\longmapsto\varphi\circ\bar u,
$$

is well defined and bijective, with inverse $\bar p\mapsto[(P,\bar p),\mathrm{id}_P]$, and it is natural in $P$ for $Y$-morphisms $P\to P'$ between etale $Y$-schemes.
